card.name: Guardian Sphinx
card.officialText: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. If this card is Flip Summoned: Return all monsters your opponent controls to the hand.

design.trigger: Flip Summon only; normal summon and effect-flip do not trigger.
design.targeting: Non-targeting. The plan stores no target list; all monsters on the opposing team's shared Monster Zones are enumerated at resolution.
design.sourceRemoval: The trigger plan resolves even if Guardian Sphinx leaves the field after activation.
design.returnDestination: Each non-token monster goes to the hand of its physical owner, determined by UID prefix; active seat uses core.players[team].hand, inactive partner uses reserves[seat].hand.
design.stolenCards: A monster controlled by the opponent but physically owned by the other team returns to its physical owner's hand.
design.faceDown: Face-down monsters are returned without publishing their identity; the adapter returns internal UIDs only.
design.tokens: Tokens leave the field and cease to exist; they are not added to any hand and are excluded from physical inventory conservation.
design.handLimit: Returned cards may raise a physical hand above 6; no discard occurs in this adapter, leaving the owner's End Phase hand-limit rule to discard to 6.
design.selfSet: Uses M550's shared once-per-turn Main Phase self-set helper, keyed by physical UID + zone epoch and persisted in JSON.
design.zones: No more than 3 Monster Zones per team; Spell/Trap, Field, Deck and Extra Deck zones are not rebuilt.
